questions.questionTextEn: The problem of desertification is least in which of the following continents?
questions.questionTextHi: [Raj. P.C.S. (Pre) 2023] The problem of desertification is least in which of the following continents?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A) Europe. Europe is the only continent without a desert. Significantly, desertification is defined by the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD) as "land degradation in and, semi-arid and dry sub-humid areas (dryland) resulting from various factors, including climatic variations and human activities. Climatic variations include the decrease in precipitation, drought or soil and moisture loss on a global level. [Raj. P.C.S. (Pre) 2023]

questions.questionTextHi: [I.A.S. questions.questionTextEn: What could be the main reason/reasons for the formation of African and Eurasian desert belt? 1. It is located in the sub-tropical high-pressure cells. 2. It is under the influence of warm ocean currents. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.questionTextHi: [I.A.S. (Pre) 2011] What could be the main reason/reasons for the formation of African and Eurasian desert belt? 1. It is located in the sub-tropical high-pressure cells. 2. It is under the influence of warm ocean currents. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A) 1 only. Most desert regions are the result of large climatic patterns. The sub-tropical high-pressure belts are adiabatic in nature hence they bring little rainfall to the African and Eurasian desert region. Warm Ocean currents are not a necessary condition for the desert belt. [I.A.S. (Pre) 2011]
questions.explanationHi: सही उत्तर: (A) 1 only। व्याख्या (10. The Arid Regions / Deserts — Arid Regions and Deserts): Most desert regions are the result of large climatic patterns. Warm Ocean currents are not a necessary condition for the desert belt. [I.A.S. (Pre) 2011]

questions.questionTextEn: Desert dwelling animals are called :
questions.questionTextHi: [U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2023] Desert dwelling animals are called :
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A) Xerocoles animals. Desert dwelling animals are called Xerocoles animals. Fossorial animals are those adapted to digging and life underground, while Arboreal are those adapted to life on the trees and Terrstrial animals are adapted to life on land. [U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2023]
